recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact graphic featuring massive, 3D block-style lettering that appears to be exploding outward from a central point, set against a dark background with intense radial light bursts. The primary text has a distinct zig-zag or 'cracked' texture on its face, rendered in a warm metallic copper-orange tone.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial light rays emanating from behind the central 3D text
Extreme perspective distortion on the 3D depth of the letters
High contrast between the dark void background and the glowing orange subject
Hierarchical stack of heavy 3D display text over clean, flat secondary typography
coreInvariants: Zig-zag vertical pattern on the face of the 3D letters
Radial blur/light ray effect originating from the center
Copper-to-gold gradient on the metallic surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary 3D text occupies the central 60% of the frame, scaled to feel monumental and aggressive.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The center point of the radial light burst, located behind the main text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the center explosion, move outward along the light rays, then settle on the secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space at the top and bottom edges to frame the central activity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and copper for the 3D text and light rays.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the secondary flat typography at the bottom.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center fading to low value/black at the periphery.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky proportions with heavy 3D extrusion
Vertical zig-zag 'lightning' pattern cut into the face of each glyph
Extreme perspective vanishing point located at the center of the canvas
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are split or segmented by the zig-zag pattern
Extrusion depth increases as letters move further from the center
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy, textured 3D display lettering and clean, minimalist wide sans-serif and script.

avoid: Flat 2D text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky weight for the 3D extrusion base.
Good for the wide, clean secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark black background with a central explosion of radial light rays in copper, gold, and amber tones. The light should appear to be bursting from a single point in the middle of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large 3D block letters in two rows. The letters must have a vertical zig-zag pattern on their face and be extruded toward the center point. Below this, add clean, wide-tracked white sans-serif text and a small line of cursive script.

verificationChecks: Does the 3D text have a zig-zag texture?
Are the light rays radiating from the center?
Is the color palette strictly copper, black, and white?
Is the perspective of the 3D extrusion consistent with a central vanishing point?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the radial light rays

avoid: Cool colors like blue or green

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D extrusion doesn't overlap to the point of illegibility.
Check that the white text at the bottom is perfectly centered.
Verify the zig-zag pattern is sharp and not blurred.
Confirm the radial light rays don't wash out the metallic texture of the letters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [3D Block Text] + [Zig-Zag Texture] + [Radial Light Burst] + [Copper/Black Palette] to recreate the high-impact Y2K energy.
